walkthroughs.body_html:
Conflict in the Middle East 1945-95 — a core area of GCSE History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Conflict in the Middle East 1945-95 brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Conflict in the Middle East 1945-95.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

options: Feudalism was a written constitution introduced by William in 1066.
